Specify import and database-loading options

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
loading_options.Rd

Configure import resources, CSV parsing, raw-cache use, and PostgreSQL loading.

Usage

loading_options(
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  temp_directory = NULL,
  table_chunk_rows = 5e+06,
  validate_columns = FALSE,
  ignore_errors = TRUE,
  store_rejects = TRUE,
  use_parquet_cache = TRUE,
  delete_source_parquet = FALSE,
  unlogged = FALSE,
  set_logged = FALSE,
  synchronous_commit_off = FALSE,
  create_indexes = TRUE
)

Arguments

memory_limit

Character string specifying a DuckDB memory limit, for example "4GB". NULL uses the receiving function's connection settings.

threads

Positive integer specifying the number of DuckDB worker threads. NULL uses the receiving function's connection settings.

temp_directory

Character string giving a directory for temporary DuckDB files. NULL uses the receiving function's temporary-directory settings.

table_chunk_rows

Positive number used as the table-size threshold for chunked cohort materialization. Default: 5e6 rows. NULL requests a single build operation per table.

validate_columns

Logical. Check imported values against configured column types. When omitted, cohort import uses FALSE and raw caching uses TRUE, including when called through the pipeline. An explicit value applies to both stages.

ignore_errors

Logical. Allow the CSV reader to skip malformed rows. Default: TRUE in this package. Use FALSE to stop on a parsing error.

store_rejects

Logical. Record rejected-row information when malformed CSV rows are skipped. Default: TRUE.

use_parquet_cache

Logical. Use an available raw Parquet cache during cohort import. Default: TRUE.

delete_source_parquet

Logical. Delete cohort Parquet files after they have been successfully loaded into PostgreSQL. Default: FALSE.

unlogged

Logical. Load PostgreSQL tables as unlogged tables. Default: FALSE. See run_db() for storage behavior.

set_logged

Logical. Convert unlogged PostgreSQL tables to logged tables after loading. Default: FALSE.

synchronous_commit_off

Logical. Disable synchronous commit during PostgreSQL loading. Default: FALSE.

create_indexes

Logical. Create the configured PostgreSQL indexes during loading. Default: TRUE.

Value

A named list of the supplied options, suitable for the loading argument of run_one_source() and compatible direct stage functions.

Details

Memory, thread, and temporary-directory settings apply to both raw caching and cohort import. Parsing and chunking settings apply to cohort import; PostgreSQL settings apply to database loading. Shared groups are validated in full, then each stage uses only the settings it supports.

Only explicitly supplied arguments are included in the result, including explicit NULL values. Omitted settings use the defaults of the receiving function. An empty options list therefore leaves its defaults unchanged.

See also

pipeline_options, run_one_source()

Examples

loading_options(memory_limit = "4GB", threads = 2, ignore_errors = FALSE)
#> $memory_limit
#> [1] "4GB"
#> 
#> $threads
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $ignore_errors
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
loading_options(create_indexes = FALSE)
#> $create_indexes
#> [1] FALSE
#>
